subject: ClearLedger POC intake: prompts & success criteria
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@clearledger.com>, Akash Rao <akash@clearledger.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & proposed POC intake for ClearLedger (next steps + data ask)

Emma / Akash — thanks for the conversation earlier. Quick recap and a proposed intake plan so we can get the POC started next week.

Call highlights
- Objective: validate Redwood inference for customer-facing transaction summarization and anomaly detection workflows.
- Success criteria (mutual): 1) 95% coverage on intent classification for top 5 intents; 2) latency <250ms p95 for interactive flows; 3) no high-severity data leakage incidents during trial.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) You provide a ~1k sample prompt/log bundle (anonymized) and an S3 or Drive transfer by Wed 5/12. See the sample schema Ben outlined below.
2) Redwood will ingest, run a short eval (classification accuracy + hallucination spot checks) by Fri 5/14 and share baseline metrics.
3) Agree on canary routing and a 2-week trial window starting Mon 5/17.

Owners
- Redwood: Ben (POC lead) + Marissa (security & onboarding)
- ClearLedger: Emma (product owner) + Akash (eng lead)

Questions
- Can your team deliver a redacted sample (logs + prompts) with at least 600 user queries and the metadata column we discussed (timestamp, user_role, raw_text, expected_label)?
- Any regulatory constraints on storage region?

I'll queue a short intake doc and a HubSpot task (deal DL-11984). If this plan looks good I'll set up a shared folder and a brief kickoff on Mon.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments referenced: sample intake CSV (template), POC timeline (stub)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@clearledger.com>, Akash Rao <akash@clearledger.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC intake for ClearLedger (next steps + data ask)

Putting the sample format and timeline in one place so the eng team has clear deliverables.

Data ask (sample bundle)
- Minimum: 600 queries (CSV) with columns: id, timestamp, user_role, raw_text, expected_label, priority_flag.
- Preferable: 1,500 rows to stabilize the evaluation. If you can only do 600 that's fine for a baseline.
- Please strip PII. If redaction is non-trivial, we can provide a safe transform script.

Transfer options (choose one)
- S3: upload to s3://clearledger-poc/incoming/ (we can share temp creds)
- Google Drive: share folder link and add marissa.cole@redwood.com
- SFTP: reach out and we can provide host & creds.

Timeline (condensed)
- Wed 5/12: sample bundle delivered by ClearLedger (target EOD).
- Fri 5/14: Redwood baseline eval + short report back (accuracy, latency, top failure modes).
- Mon 5/17: start 2-week canary (we'll instrument cost/latency dashboards).

Evaluation plan overview
- Metrics: classification accuracy (micro/macro), false positive rate on anomaly detection, p95 latency for API calls, and a qualitative hallucination audit across 100 flagged examples.
- Success thresholds: accuracy >= 0.85 for top intents; p95 latency < 250ms; no more than 2% critical hallucinations in audit sample.
- Ownership: Redwood runs initial eval; ClearLedger provides expected_labels for the sample dataset.

If acceptable, I'll send the intake template (CSV) and set up an S3 bucket with temp credentials; Marissa will follow on the security checklist.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0124

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@clearledger.com>, Akash Rao <akash@clearledger.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC intake for ClearLedger (next steps + data ask)

Hi Emma / Akash — looping in security/onboarding details and a short checklist for the transfer.

Security checklist (quick)
- Data redaction: ensure no unredacted PII; if removing PII is difficult, mark fields and we'll coordinate a transform.
- Region: Confirm that data must stay in us-west-2 (OK for Redwood hosted POC).
- Access: Provide a single writer principal for upload; Redwood will remove creds after ingestion.

Transfer instructions (preferred: S3)
1) I'll create an S3 bucket (s3://clearledger-poc/incoming) and post temporary credentials to your engineering lead (akash@clearledger.com) via our secure share tool.
2) Upload one file named clearledger_sample_prompts_20270511.csv (CSV, UTF-8) and a short README.txt describing any non-standard columns.

Attachments in this thread (stubs):
- redwood_soc2_summary_20270510.pdf (SOC 2 summary & what we can share for audits)
- intake_template.csv (CSV template with header row)

Privacy note: Redwood will only use the sample for evaluation and will delete the sample after 90 days unless you request otherwise. We can also sign a limited purpose addendum if needed.

Let me know if you'd like us to run a small anonymization pass before ingestion — we can do that as a quick step (<1 day).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Onboarding & Security Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

---
Attachment: redwood_soc2_summary_20270510.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: intake_template.csv (text/csv)

From: Emma Li <emma@clearledger.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & proposed POC intake for ClearLedger (next steps + data ask)

Thanks Jordan — appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers and confirmation from our side.

- We can deliver ~1,200 queries by Wed 5/12. We'll provide expected_label for the top-level intent buckets.
- Region: US-only storage is required (us-west-2 is fine).
- Transfer: we'll use Google Drive for the sample (security team prefers Drive with restricted link). I've uploaded a first batch to the shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cClearLedgerSamples — file: clearledger_sample_prompts_20270511.csv (first 1,200 rows).

A couple of flags:
- There are several rows where expected_label is ambiguous (we are including a confidence column). We can either include those with a low_confidence flag or exclude them — prefer you run with them and mark them as low_confidence.
- We also have one sample PII column (user_email) — we've redacted 95% but left a user_hash column. If Redwood prefers a second sanitization pass let us know.

We agree to the timeline; if you can share the baseline report Friday that will help our product team decide the scope for the canary on Mon.

Emma
Emma Li
Product Manager | ClearLedger
emma@clearledger.com
